title: Data loss
body: The whole structure of the app is well made, but I absolutely HATE IT, because it started crashing, was not responsive, then I cleared out some space on my phone, installed the most recent update, but more than HALF of the notes disappeared and organization was undone. I lost some really precious things and I hate the app for it
